statement: NVIDIA says Hugging Face will stay an open platform supporting multi-cloud and multi-accelerator development after the acquisition closes.
why: An explicit neutrality pledge keeps the largest model repository usable on rival accelerators, so the deal does not by itself foreclose non-NVIDIA silicon from the open-model channel.

impact.mechanism: Continued multi-accelerator support preserves a distribution path for alternative silicon, partly offsetting the lock-in effect of NVIDIA owning the platform.

evidence.excerpt: will remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: stated commitment in NVIDIA's own acquisition announcement.
